product.production_short: Production typically takes 1–3 business days from order confirmation.
product.production_peak: During peak periods (Black Friday, Christmas, Mother's / Father's Day) please allow up to 8 business days.
product.shipping_short: Standard shipping with Australia Post is 3–7 business days.
product.pickup_melbourne_only: Collection in person is available within the Melbourne metropolitan area only. We'll confirm pickup details when your order is ready.
